name: Graham Pudding
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)

ingredients.item: 1 cup raisins, seeded and cut in pieces

steps: Melt butter, add molasses, milk, egg well beaten, dry ingredients mixed and sifted, and raisins; turn into buttered mould, cover, and steam two and one-half hours.
Dates or figs cut in small pieces may be used in place of raisins.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
